about.en: FAR is the token of FAR Labs, formerly the Farcana shooter-game project, which now builds FAR AI, a distributed inference network that routes AI requests across consumer and enterprise GPUs, and pays compute providers and stakers in FAR. It is a BEP-20 on BNB Chain at 0xc44f9f08e524669e5deeebc9eb142c81edfad178, whose on-chain name is still Farcana.
